lines.text: The red-legged Rapture moves chaotically through the air.
As the Glass Slippers' light pierces through the Rapture,
it extends its tentacles, which impale Cinderella.
After this final attack, the Rapture explodes, sending pieces flying every which way.
Cinderella hastily cuts off the tentacle that pierced through her.
An invisible wall appears in front of Cinderella once again,
beyond which she can see herself and her colleagues.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: And you brought your friends along too.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: Now, let's go over your mission once again.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: You don't want to see your friends killed by your own hand, do you?

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: State your mission. Then you can be at ease.
Cinderella looks at the version of herself beyond the wall,
and sees her friends looking back at her.
Hansel and Gretel are running towards her.
Abe is grabbing her shoulders and shaking her.
She sees herself staring blankly into space.
Cinderella looks back into Abe's eyes.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I won't allow myself to be tainted anymore.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I have someone in my corner watching me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I have to be beautiful in their eyes.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: The thought of your filth blighting my beauty

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Damn it, don't do this to me! We're so close!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You look like you're about to cry.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Your Goddess of Victory will never be tarnished.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Oh man... my heart can't take much more of this.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I will never inflict any pain on any of you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: It's time to take down the Queen.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Everyone, keep your head on a swivel.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: There's no knowing what we might find inside the Lift.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: No way you'd be riding this if you had a fear of heights.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I think it's strange.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: The world as we know it has changed significantly, but from here, it looks as if not much has happened.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Abe. How long until we reach the space station?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Assuming that nothing goes wrong, we should arrive in one hour.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: While it's technically a freight elevator, the speed is more akin to a shuttle.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Is there something on your mind?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'm just feeling confident that we got it right.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: The freight elevator is operating normally. If you look around, you can see all different sizes of scratches.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: So our theory that they used this to send the Raptures down to the surface must be correct.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: They're made at the space station, and transported using this Lift.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: So, if things go south, if we just detach the space station...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: How about destroying the Lift itself?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: That's essentially impossible. It's too big. And thanks to Gluttony, the use of large-scale weapons is prohibited.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Only small groups like us could have made it this far.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I think it's a bit hot in here.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Really? Could the temperature regulation system be broken?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... Don't worry. Abe is looking into...
A giant beam blasts through and vaporizes half the elevator.
The resulting drop in air pressure causes everything to shake violently.
Abe and Cinderella instinctively cling to the wall.
Half of the elevator has been completely vaporized, as if it never existed. The edges near where the beam hit are glowing a flaming red.
Abe stares at the scene, dumbfounded.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Pull yourself together! I'm sure everyone's safe.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: How could they be, when we're this high up?!
Another beam strikes down on them.
Another gaping hole is torn in the elevator.
Abe is barely clinging onto the newly severed area.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: This attack is from the Queen, I'm certain of it.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: She's armed with a high-output beam weapon. If you use Glass Slippers, we might stand a chance.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: So long as it's not destroyed entirely, this elevator will continue to ascend.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Deploy Glass Slippers, and keep going up.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: If you think you can't win, detach the station.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: That way, you'll at least be able to cut off the supply route for the Raptures.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You need to continue the story.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: How can I do it alone?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: are my most beautiful Goddess of Victory.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: We'll all be waiting for you down below.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'll find you, no matter what happens!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I will come back to you victorious!
Abe loses her grip, and plummets down.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'll win this for you, and return to you.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: We've received orders from up high.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Destroy all information related to the second generation Grimms models.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Operation Ark Guardian was a success. Now we just need to seal the Ark.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: If it weren't for Liliweiss, it would have been impossible.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: The operation succeeded, but we lost the Goddess of Victory herself.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: We can't allow such failures to continue to exist at such a pivotal moment.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: None of the Grimms models can be allowed to fail again.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: They must be made examples of.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Yes. I will leave it to you.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: All I can do is wipe the slate clean.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: I don't know when it will be,

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: but if there ever comes a time when we can resume your stories again,

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: my hope is that the newly cleansed slate will only contain beautiful stories.
